text:
Aisha: Noticed a small but widespread churn in Contact Owner assignments after last night's playbook run. ~6% of accounts lost owners (mostly low-touch).
Ben: saw it too in the owners-sync dashboard. looks tied to the new fingerprint dedupe step.
Carlos: remind me what changed in that dedupe? I reviewed PR but skimmed the fallback logic.
Aisha: the dedupe now prefers matching on email_hash > phone_hash > canonical_id; it also nulls owner if multiple contacts merge with conflicting owner fields.
Ben: aha, merging with conflicting owners explains the nulls. previously we retained the earliest non-null owner.
Carlos: quick mitigation: instead of nulling, we should set owner = 'owner_conflict' label and surface in ops queue. doing a full null forces playbooks to treat them as unowned.
Aisha: good idea. can we patch and run a fast reapply? also we should avoid triggering playbook auto-reassign until owners are reconciled.
Ben: action items: 1) rollback auto-reassign trigger (queued), 2) patch dedupe to emit conflict labels and preserve previous_owner field, 3) backfill owners where previous_owner exists.
Carlos: SQL snippet to find affected accounts:
```
SELECT account_id, merged_contacts, previous_owner, owner_after
FROM cs_ops.dedupe_audit
WHERE change_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-02 02:00' AND '2026-03-02 03:00' AND owner_after IS NULL;
```
Aisha: I'll open the rollback ticket and mark the high-value cohorts (Enterprise + MidMarket) as manual only for reassignment.
cs-bot: :information_source: Playbook-runner v1.12.0 deployed by Ben at 02:17 UTC. rollback scheduled at 02:30 UTC if unresolved.
Ben: rolling back auto-reassign now. will post back when complete.
Aisha: once rolled back, let's run a reconciliation job that prefers previous_owner, then a small opt-in manual review for conflicts.
Carlos: agree. add a post-deploy sanity check that flags >1% owner nulls in any cohort within 1h.
Aisha: thanks team. please add the reconciliation run to the rollback ticket so CS can prep outreach if needed. :thumbsup:
